categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Mempool' and modifies mempool eviction logic during reorganizations in src/validation.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where valid BIP68 transactions spending unconfirmed inputs are erroneously evicted from the mempool along with their descendants during reorgs. Issue #35007 and reproducer tests show that cached lockpoints calculated at older tips cause sequence-lock failures at the new tip even when TestLockPointValidity passes, which recalculation prevents.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/validation.cpp in removeForReorg, but the category excludes PRs whose primary subject is mempool policy or eviction.
categories.rationale: The change recalculates mempool lockpoints to prevent improper eviction during reorgs, which is an eviction and mempool maintenance issue excluded from validation by definition.
